// fx.h
#pragma once
// Generated by logue-patcher's logue-codegen.
// NOT hand-written -- do not edit directly, re-export instead.
#include "processor.h"
#include "unit_delfx.h"
#include <cmath>

// Effects link no oscillator API -- stand-ins for the two symbols primitives use.
#define osc_sinf fx_sinf
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float osc_w0f_for_note(uint8_t note, uint8_t mod)
{
  const float f = 440.f * fastpow2f(((float)note + (float)mod * (1.f / 255.f) - 69.f) * (1.f / 12.f));
  return (f < 23679.643054f ? f : 23679.643054f) * (1.f / 48000.f);
}

class Fx : public Processor
{
public:
  // Floats of SDRAM unit_init allocates and hands to init().
  uint32_t getBufferSize() const override final { return 65536u; }

  void setParameter(uint8_t index, int32_t value) override final
  {
    switch (index)
    {
    case 0: time01_ = param_10bit_to_f32(value); break;
    case 1: depth01_ = param_10bit_to_f32(value); break;
    case 2: mix01_ = (value + 1000) * (1.f / 2000.f); break;
    default: break;
    }
  }

  void init(float *sdram) override final
  {
    sdram_n = sdram + 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 65536u; ++i) sdram[i] = 0.f;
    note_ = 60.f;
    noteFine_ = 0.f;
    tempo_ = 120.f;
    time01_ = 0.f;
    depth01_ = 0.f;
    mix01_ = 0.5f;
    w_n = 0u;
    delay_n = 0.f;
    dampZ_n = 0.f;
    len_n = (1) >= 3 ? 262144u : (1) >= 2 ? 131072u : (1) >= 1 ? 65536u : 16384u;
    timePercent_n = 25;
    sync_n = 0;
    div_n = (int)(5);
    feedbackPercent_n = 35;
    dampingPercent_n = 20;
    mixPercent_n = 50;
  }

  // Korg's README: clear delay lines and state, keep param values (len_ and the dials stay).
  void reset() override final
  {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 65536u; ++i) sdram_n[i] = 0.f;
    w_n = 0u;
    delay_n = 0.f;
    dampZ_n = 0.f;
  }

  void setTempo(float bpm) override final { tempo_ = bpm; }

  // Every input sample is read before the frame's outputs are written: the SDK allows the
  // firmware to pass one buffer as both in and out.
  void process(const float *in, float *out, uint32_t frames) override final
  {
    (void)in;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
    {
      float y_n = long_delay_step(sdram_n, len_n - 1u, &w_n, &delay_n, long_delay_target(sync_n, timePercent_n, div_n, tempo_, len_n), 0.f, (feedbackPercent_n) * 0.0098f, 1.f - dampingPercent_n * 0.0095f, &dampZ_n, mixPercent_n * 0.01f);
      out[2 * i] = clip1m1f(y_n);
      out[2 * i + 1] = clip1m1f(y_n);
    }
  }

private:
  // The note a primitive that follows the played note (an oscillator's pitch, a TRACK filter)
  // reads: an effect gets none, so it's a fixed middle C.
  float note_;
  float noteFine_;
  // The fixed knobs' positions (0..1), as the device reports them.
  float time01_;
  float depth01_;
  float mix01_;
  // The device tempo in BPM, 120 until the device gives one.
  float tempo_;
  float *sdram_n;
  uint32_t len_n;
  uint32_t w_n;
  float delay_n;
  float dampZ_n;
  float timePercent_n;
  float feedbackPercent_n;
  float dampingPercent_n;
  float mixPercent_n;
  float sync_n;
  int div_n;

  static float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi)
  {
    return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
  }

  // The delay in samples: TIME percent of the line, or a DIVISION of a beat at the device
  // tempo while synced -- clamped to what the line (length len) can hold.
  static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float long_delay_target(float sync, float timePercent, int div, float bpm, uint32_t len)
  {
    static const float beats[10] = {0.25f, 1.f / 3.f, 0.5f, 0.75f, 2.f / 3.f, 1.f, 1.5f, 2.f, 3.f, 4.f};
    const float maxDelay = (float)(len - 2u);
    float d;
    if (sync >= 1.f)
    {
      const int i = div < 0 ? 0 : (div > 9 ? 9 : div);
      d = (2880000.f / (bpm < 20.f ? 20.f : bpm)) * beats[i];
    }
    else
    {
      d = 1.f + timePercent * 0.01f * (maxDelay - 1.f);
    }
    return d < 1.f ? 1.f : (d > maxDelay ? maxDelay : d);
  }

  // One echo on a line in SDRAM: reads at a smoothed delay (so a TIME change glides like tape),
  // then writes the input plus the damped feedback, softly limited like comb_step's (linear to
  // 0.6, ceiling 1.0) so FEEDBACK 100 can't run away. Returns dry-to-wet by mix. A leaf.
  static float long_delay_step(float *buf, uint32_t mask, uint32_t *w, float *delay, float target, float x, float fb, float dampA, float *dampZ, float mix)
  {
    if (*delay < 1.f) *delay = target;
    *delay += (target - *delay) * 0.0005f;
    const uint32_t di = (uint32_t)*delay;
    const float frac = *delay - (float)di;
    const float a = buf[(*w - di) & mask];
    const float b = buf[(*w - di - 1u) & mask];
    const float wet = a + (b - a) * frac;
    *dampZ += dampA * (wet - *dampZ);
    float stored = x + fb * *dampZ;
    float mag = stored < 0.f ? -stored : stored;
    if (mag > 0.6f)
    {
      float over = mag - 0.6f;
      if (over > 0.8f) over = 0.8f;
      mag = 0.6f + over - 0.625f * over * over;
      stored = stored < 0.f ? -mag : mag;
    }
    buf[*w & mask] = stored;
    *w = *w + 1u;
    return x + (wet - x) * mix;
  }
};

// fx.h
#pragma once
// Generated by logue-patcher's logue-codegen.
// NOT hand-written -- do not edit directly, re-export instead.
#include "processor.h"
#include "unit_delfx.h"
#include <cmath>

// Effects link no oscillator API -- stand-ins for the two symbols primitives use.
#define osc_sinf fx_sinf
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float osc_w0f_for_note(uint8_t note, uint8_t mod)
{
  const float f = 440.f * fastpow2f(((float)note + (float)mod * (1.f / 255.f) - 69.f) * (1.f / 12.f));
  return (f < 23679.643054f ? f : 23679.643054f) * (1.f / 48000.f);
}

class Fx : public Processor
{
public:
  // Floats of SDRAM unit_init allocates and hands to init().
  uint32_t getBufferSize() const override final { return 65536u; }

  void setParameter(uint8_t index, int32_t value) override final
  {
    switch (index)
    {
    case 0: time01_ = param_10bit_to_f32(value); break;
    case 1: depth01_ = param_10bit_to_f32(value); break;
    case 2: mix01_ = (value + 1000) * (1.f / 2000.f); break;
    default: break;
    }
  }

  void init(float *sdram) override final
  {
    sdram_n = sdram + 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 65536u; ++i) sdram[i] = 0.f;
    note_ = 60.f;
    noteFine_ = 0.f;
    tempo_ = 120.f;
    time01_ = 0.f;
    depth01_ = 0.f;
    mix01_ = 0.5f;
    w_n = 0u;
    delay_n = 0.f;
    dampZ_n = 0.f;
    value_c_in = 37 * 0.01f;
    value_c_time = 37 * 0.01f;
    value_c_feedback = 37 * 0.01f;
    len_n = (1) >= 3 ? 262144u : (1) >= 2 ? 131072u : (1) >= 1 ? 65536u : 16384u;
    timePercent_n = 25;
    sync_n = 100;
    div_n = (int)(5);
    feedbackPercent_n = 35;
    dampingPercent_n = 20;
    mixPercent_n = 50;
  }

  // Korg's README: clear delay lines and state, keep param values (len_ and the dials stay).
  void reset() override final
  {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 65536u; ++i) sdram_n[i] = 0.f;
    w_n = 0u;
    delay_n = 0.f;
    dampZ_n = 0.f;
  }

  void setTempo(float bpm) override final { tempo_ = bpm; }

  // Every input sample is read before the frame's outputs are written: the SDK allows the
  // firmware to pass one buffer as both in and out.
  void process(const float *in, float *out, uint32_t frames) override final
  {
    (void)in;
      float y_c_in = value_c_in;
      float y_c_time = value_c_time;
      float y_c_feedback = value_c_feedback;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
    {
      float y_n = long_delay_step(sdram_n, len_n - 1u, &w_n, &delay_n, long_delay_target(sync_n, clampf(timePercent_n + (y_c_time) * 50.f, 0.f, 100.f), div_n, tempo_, len_n), y_c_in, (clampf(feedbackPercent_n + (y_c_feedback) * 50.f, 0.f, 100.f)) * 0.0098f, 1.f - dampingPercent_n * 0.0095f, &dampZ_n, mixPercent_n * 0.01f);
      out[2 * i] = clip1m1f(y_n);
      out[2 * i + 1] = clip1m1f(y_n);
    }
  }

private:
  // The note a primitive that follows the played note (an oscillator's pitch, a TRACK filter)
  // reads: an effect gets none, so it's a fixed middle C.
  float note_;
  float noteFine_;
  // The fixed knobs' positions (0..1), as the device reports them.
  float time01_;
  float depth01_;
  float mix01_;
  // The device tempo in BPM, 120 until the device gives one.
  float tempo_;
  float *sdram_n;
  float value_c_in;
  float value_c_time;
  float value_c_feedback;
  uint32_t len_n;
  uint32_t w_n;
  float delay_n;
  float dampZ_n;
  float timePercent_n;
  float feedbackPercent_n;
  float dampingPercent_n;
  float mixPercent_n;
  float sync_n;
  int div_n;

  static float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi)
  {
    return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
  }

  // The delay in samples: TIME percent of the line, or a DIVISION of a beat at the device
  // tempo while synced -- clamped to what the line (length len) can hold.
  static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float long_delay_target(float sync, float timePercent, int div, float bpm, uint32_t len)
  {
    static const float beats[10] = {0.25f, 1.f / 3.f, 0.5f, 0.75f, 2.f / 3.f, 1.f, 1.5f, 2.f, 3.f, 4.f};
    const float maxDelay = (float)(len - 2u);
    float d;
    if (sync >= 1.f)
    {
      const int i = div < 0 ? 0 : (div > 9 ? 9 : div);
      d = (2880000.f / (bpm < 20.f ? 20.f : bpm)) * beats[i];
    }
    else
    {
      d = 1.f + timePercent * 0.01f * (maxDelay - 1.f);
    }
    return d < 1.f ? 1.f : (d > maxDelay ? maxDelay : d);
  }

  // One echo on a line in SDRAM: reads at a smoothed delay (so a TIME change glides like tape),
  // then writes the input plus the damped feedback, softly limited like comb_step's (linear to
  // 0.6, ceiling 1.0) so FEEDBACK 100 can't run away. Returns dry-to-wet by mix. A leaf.
  static float long_delay_step(float *buf, uint32_t mask, uint32_t *w, float *delay, float target, float x, float fb, float dampA, float *dampZ, float mix)
  {
    if (*delay < 1.f) *delay = target;
    *delay += (target - *delay) * 0.0005f;
    const uint32_t di = (uint32_t)*delay;
    const float frac = *delay - (float)di;
    const float a = buf[(*w - di) & mask];
    const float b = buf[(*w - di - 1u) & mask];
    const float wet = a + (b - a) * frac;
    *dampZ += dampA * (wet - *dampZ);
    float stored = x + fb * *dampZ;
    float mag = stored < 0.f ? -stored : stored;
    if (mag > 0.6f)
    {
      float over = mag - 0.6f;
      if (over > 0.8f) over = 0.8f;
      mag = 0.6f + over - 0.625f * over * over;
      stored = stored < 0.f ? -mag : mag;
    }
    buf[*w & mask] = stored;
    *w = *w + 1u;
    return x + (wet - x) * mix;
  }
};

// unit.cc
// Generated by logue-patcher's logue-codegen.
// NOT hand-written -- do not edit directly, re-export instead.
#include "fx.h"
#include "unit_delfx.h"
#include "utils/int_math.h"

static Fx s_fx_instance;
static int32_t cached_values[UNIT_MAX_PARAM_COUNT];

__unit_callback int8_t unit_init(const unit_runtime_desc_t *desc)
{
  if (!desc)
    return k_unit_err_undef;
  if (desc->target != unit_header.target)
    return k_unit_err_target;
  if (!UNIT_API_IS_COMPAT(desc->api))
    return k_unit_err_api_version;
  if (desc->samplerate != s_fx_instance.getSampleRate())
    return k_unit_err_samplerate;
  if (desc->input_channels != 2 || desc->output_channels != 2)
    return k_unit_err_geometry;

  float *sdram = nullptr;
  const uint32_t sdramFloats = s_fx_instance.getBufferSize();
  if (sdramFloats > 0)
  {
    if (!desc->hooks.sdram_alloc)
      return k_unit_err_memory;
    sdram = reinterpret_cast<float *>(desc->hooks.sdram_alloc(sdramFloats * sizeof(float)));
    if (!sdram)
      return k_unit_err_memory;
  }
  s_fx_instance.init(sdram);
  for (int id = 0; id < UNIT_MAX_PARAM_COUNT; ++id)
  {
    cached_values[id] = static_cast<int32_t>(unit_header.params[id].init);
  }
  return k_unit_err_none;
}

__unit_callback void unit_teardown() { s_fx_instance.teardown(); }
__unit_callback void unit_reset() { s_fx_instance.reset(); }
__unit_callback void unit_resume() { s_fx_instance.resume(); }
__unit_callback void unit_suspend() { s_fx_instance.suspend(); }

__unit_callback void unit_render(const float *in, float *out, uint32_t frames)
{
  s_fx_instance.process(in, out, frames);
}

__unit_callback void unit_set_param_value(uint8_t id, int32_t value)
{
  value = clipminmaxi32(unit_header.params[id].min, value, unit_header.params[id].max);
  cached_values[id] = value;
  s_fx_instance.setParameter(id, value);
}
__unit_callback int32_t unit_get_param_value(uint8_t id) { return cached_values[id]; }
__unit_callback const char *unit_get_param_str_value(uint8_t id, int32_t value)
{
  value = clipminmaxi32(unit_header.params[id].min, value, unit_header.params[id].max);
  switch (id)
  {
  case 5:
  {
    static const char *const strs[] = {"1/16", "1/8T", "1/8", "1/8D", "1/4T", "1/4", "1/4D", "1/2", "1/2D", "1/1"};
    return strs[value - 0];
  }
  default: break;
  }
  return nullptr;
}

// UQ16.16 BPM (Korg's README; its templates convert it the same way).
__unit_callback void unit_set_tempo(uint32_t tempo)
{
  s_fx_instance.setTempo((tempo >> 16) + (tempo & 0xFFFF) / static_cast<float>(0x10000));
}
__unit_callback void unit_tempo_4ppqn_tick(uint32_t) {}
